title: DEMIURGE Google Flow generation queue (textures and look concepts)
by: lead's build agent, track flow-queue (documents only; the lead runs Flow)
target_look: Stylised realism for the strategy camera: clean readable shapes, simplified but believable materials, a controlled palette slightly richer than real life, physically lit; each age and culture keeps a signature palette; roofs and walls separate at a glance at 300 m. The approved orbit look (shots/ue-cloudlab-terminator-final.png) does not change.

flow_settings.credit_check: the chip must read "Generating will use 0 credits"; stop if it does not

templates.S2: Seamless tileable stylized game texture of <subject>, seen straight on|seen straight from above, the square shows about <n> metres, stylized realism, crisp clean surfaces, larger simpler shapes, subtle colour variation, slightly saturated, painterly finish, natural material detail kept but simplified, no outlines, not cartoonish, detail spread evenly with no single feature crossing the whole square, flat even lighting, no shadows, no perspective, fills the whole square edge to edge, no text
templates.S1: Seamless tileable stylized game texture of <subject>, ..., the square shows about <n> metres, hand-painted look, clean readable shapes, simplified detail, soft painted highlights on the top edges, gentle dark accents in the gaps, warm natural colours slightly richer than real life, no outlines, detail spread evenly with no single feature crossing the whole square, flat even lighting, no shadows, no perspective, fills the whole square edge to edge, no text
templates.note: S2 is the recorded pilot S2 wording (art/style-pilot/flow/S2/*.provenance.json) plus guards against the cartoon drift the pilot images show (bold outlines, toy-like grass): "natural material detail kept but simplified, no outlines, not cartoonish" and a no-large-feature rule for clean tiling. To switch the whole queue to S1, rebuild each tileable prompt with the S1 tail; every job keeps its subject in the prompt between the head and ", seen".

how_to_run: Work top to bottom (rank). Tier 0 are three look anchors: generate them first and judge every texture pick against them.
One Flow generation per job with 4 images. Download all 4 as "2K upscaled".
Ingest each: python tools/flow_provenance.py ingest "<download>" <dest with a, b, c or d> --prompt="<the job prompt, exact>". The dest pattern is in each job.
Pick the best of 4 against the anchors and the job notes. Reject any image where one structure runs across the whole tile in both directions, has outlines, text, perspective or baked shadows.

Process the pick with art/textures-pilot/make_maps.py (stylised sets: 0.6 x normal tilt, 2.5 px pre-blur, as style_maps.py SOFT), at the job tile_m, then hand the set to the family that the job purpose names.
Jobs with "existing" already have one pilot image; skip them if that image is approved.
Jobs with "replaces" supersede that folder of the photoreal library in art/textures-flow/ (keep the photoreal set as fallback until the S2 set is in the game).
ingest_note: tools/flow_provenance.py ingest accepts only 2048 x 2048 JPEGs. The 16:9 jobs (concepts and two UI backdrops) need either a square crop before ingest or an --aspect option added to the tool by its owner; until then record their provenance by hand in the same format.

tiers.1: what fills the screen at 80-300 m: main grass, earth, the five signature roofs, main walls, ripe and ploughed fields, forest floor, rock, beach and shoreline, three mid-scale macros
tiers.2: every remaining biome (close and mid), roads and paths, and the building kits of all seven ages
tiers.3: culture accents, wonders, shrine, water edges
tiers.4: crops, people fabrics, animal hides, props, ships, tree bark
tiers.5: UI backgrounds, sky, extra look concepts
